s_01: Dawn on a wide river in very dense fog, the water and the sky melting into one grey; a muddy sandy bank with washed-up branches and a broken boat plank in the foreground; two small figures seen from behind, a man and a woman in wet peasant clothes, standing apart in the fog, just finding each other
s_06: Night beside an old salt-boilers' log hut on a hill: a low stove of stones freshly plastered with wet clay, a fire glowing in its mouth, and on top a wide shallow rusty iron pan, steam rising from it into the dark; a bucket and tools nearby
s_07: A drowned grove: dead black oaks without bark standing knee-deep in still dark water, twisted roots and snags, a cold mist between the trunks, grey morning light
s_15: An old stone and timber dam across a marsh river with three wooden sluice gates and big iron-bound winches; one gate just opened and water roaring through it in white foam; dusk
s_16: On top of an old stone dam at dusk, seen from behind two small figures (a man and a woman, backs to the viewer) facing, some paces away, a broad man in a long white cloak with two big grey dogs beside him; wind, the river below; a tense standoff; the man in white is in shadow, his face not visible
s_31: Deep cart ruts in the mud leading out of a reed marsh up onto dry steppe of grey wormwood and feather grass, a wide beaten road far on the horizon, a huge sky, midday
s_37: Night: clay pits behind a long wooden fence with a gate, a wooden watchtower with a single lantern, the marsh beyond under a dark sky; quiet and tense
s_42: Midnight at a salt-works seen from inside its palisade: the wooden gate closed and barred, a big shaggy grey dog standing alert facing it, a man with a cudgel in shadow by the gate seen from behind, and beyond the sharpened stakes in the dark a row of torches of men waiting
s_47: Dusk at a ford into a wooded ravine on the steppe: two loaded ox carts with big wooden wheels waiting at the water, oxen standing, and in the dark bushes of the ravine several pairs of wolf eyes glinting
